messages:
alex: FYI scheduling a small rolling maintenance in us-west2 Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC. Goal: node-label reshuffle + rolling host reboots to clear lingering driver state. Expect ~16 nodes in 4 batches of 4.
sam: Will this hit production model-serving pools?
alex: Yes but we'll steer traffic to burst and dedicated pools. KV/prefix cache cold starts are the main risk for p95.
maria: Can we pre-seed caches? That helped last time.
kevin: We should. Run kvseed on backfill nodes ~20m before each batch. Also set router fallback to variant-small for heavy tenants.
alex: Plan outline:
1) 01:30 UTC - preflight checks, prometheus health, and create canary cordon (2 nodes)
2) 01:40 UTC - kv-seed canary: `kubectl -n inference run kv-seed --image=ghcr.io/redwood/kv-seeder:stable -- /seed --pool=canary`
3) 01:50 UTC - validate canary metrics (p50/p95, kvcache-hit-rate, errors)
4) 02:00 UTC - start batch 1 (4 nodes): cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon -> postseed
5) repeat batches every ~20m, stop if p95 > 750ms for >3m
sam: Cost to keep burst pools hot? we should quantify.
engops-bot: estimated burst cost for window: ~0.5% monthly infra spend if fully utilized. Authorize?
maria: Authorize up to 1% spend threshold, alert if exceeded.
kevin: Add 5m to drain grace to help local disk eviction: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=10m`
alex: Owners: batch1/2 sam, batch3/4 maria, final backfill kevin. I'll own the routing change.
maria: Also require deterministic seeds for canary evals so comparison is stable. I'll add seed param to kv-seed.
sam: I'll take smoke checks after batch 1 and monitor dashboards. If error rate rises >2% we pause.
oncall-bot: scheduled_maintenance created id=sm-2021749994321 start=2025-07-15T02:00:00Z notify_channels=[#eng-infra,#support] pagerduty=on-high-error
alex: Docs/runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/rolling-reboot-node-labels (pinned in channel).
engops-bot: I'll prepare a small customer blurb for support: low-likelihood latency blips, proactive notice only if impact observed.
kevin: Small note: watch ephemeral-nvme pressure during drains; may trigger unexpected pod reschedules. Add metric check for node.disk.used% > 85% pre-cordon.
maria: Good catch. Also run quick local agent test post-uncordon to verify KV hit-rate >= 70%.
sam: Quick sanity script for smoke check:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://api.internal/health?model=baseline")
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ]; then
  echo "health failed: $HTTP_CODE"; exit 2
fi
# run short prompt and check latency < 500ms
```
alex: If any batch fails the SLO pause the plan and rollback router changes. Pagerduty escalation per runbook.
sam: I'll be on preflight channel at 01:45 UTC. :eyes:
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update sm ticket with owners and cost cap. :thumbsup:
